## Problem

What user-visible behavior or engineering limitation does this change address?

## Changes

Explain the resulting behavior and link the related issue.

## Validation

List the meaningful checks and their results. Link the completed workflow run when available.

For device changes, record the tested model, firmware, and directly observed result. Keep browser previews, accepted control requests, native execution, and behavior after restart distinct. Keep personal configuration, credentials, and raw device reports out of the pull request.
